newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HORSE RACING-Saintly tipped as Melbourne Cup favourite.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Saintly tipped as Melbourne Cup favourite.

text.p: The Bart Cummings-trained Saintly could displace Irish raider Oscar Schindler as favourite for Tuesday's A$2.2 million Melbourne Cup horse race, a leading Australian bookmaker said on Monday.
A spokeswoman for Mark Read's Darwin All-Sports said the four-year-old gelding, winner of the recent Cox Plate, was currently second favourite at 5-1.
Oscar Schindler, Irish St Leger winner and third in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, was favourite at 4-1 and was drifting in the market.
"We think Saintly will start as favourite," said the spokeswoman.
Randwick trainer Cummings has won a record nine Melbourne Cups.
Third favourite was last year's Nothin' Leica Dane, at 7-1, with last year's winner Doriemus and Senator both on 8-1.
